speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the breast mass you are experiencing, including its location, size, and how long you have had it. Also, tell me if you have noticed any changes in skin texture, nipple discharge, or lymph node swelling.

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor. The patient's description of a rapidly enlarging breast mass over just 4 weeks is highly characteristic of a Phyllodes tumor rather than a typical fibroadenoma or carcinoma. I would like to request a breast ultrasound to assess the mass's characteristics and vascularity. REQUEST TEST: Breast_Ultrasound.
